question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Rudimentary
solution:
The correct answer is: **Elementary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Rudimentary"** refers to something that is basic, simple, or in its initial stages of development; it is not fully developed or advanced. (आधारभूत)
 
 
• **Example: **The villagers used rudimentary tools to build their houses.
 
 
• **"Elementary"** is the synonym for rudimentary as it also refers to something that is basic, fundamental, or introductory. (मूलभूत)
 
 
• **Example: **She has an elementary understanding of mathematics but is eager to learn more.
 
 
• Hence, **"Elementary"** is the most appropriate synonym for the word "Rudimentary."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Elementary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Advanced** (उन्नत): Refers to something that is at a higher level of development or complexity.
 
 
• **Example:** The course is designed for students with advanced knowledge of physics.
 
 
• **Complex** (जटिल): Refers to something that has many interconnected parts and is not simple.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions for the machine were too complex for a beginner to understand.
 
 
• **Intricate** (जटिल और विस्तृत): Refers to something that is very detailed and complicated.
 
 
• **Example:** The intricate design of the jewelry impressed everyone at the exhibition.
 

36:T966,

The correct answer is option 1.</
